Implement console warnings in the Grid2 component to notify developers when legacy props are used. Ensure these warnings are clear, specific, and only appear once per application session to prevent console spam.

*   Emit a console warning when the `item` prop is passed to the Grid2 component.
    *   Use the message: 'MUI Grid2: The `item` prop has been removed and is no longer necessary. You can safely remove it.'
    *   Ensure this warning is emitted only once per session.
*   Emit a console warning when the `zeroMinWidth` prop is passed to the Grid2 component.
    *   Use the message: 'MUI Grid2: The `zeroMinWidth` prop has been removed and is no longer necessary. You can safely remove it.'
    *   Ensure this warning is emitted only once per session.
*   Emit a console warning for any theme breakpoint prop (e.g., xs, sm, md, lg, xl) passed to the Grid2 component.
    *   Use the message pattern: 'MUI Grid2: The `{breakpoint}` prop has been removed. See https://mui.com/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/ for migration instructions.'
    *   Replace `{breakpoint}` with the actual prop name.
    *   Ensure each breakpoint warning is emitted only once per session.
*   Update the `replaceMaterialLinks` utility to handle URL transformations.
    *   Map the path `/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/` to `/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/`.
    *   Ensure the old path `/migration/migration-grid-v2/` is no longer used.

**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.

Based on my search, here's what I found about the MUI Grid2 `item` prop warning:

## Source of the Warning

The warning stems from the migration to **Grid v2** (now simply called `Grid` or `Grid2`), where the `item` and `zeroMinWidth` props have been removed in the updated Grid. In Grid v2, all grids are considered items without specifying the `item` prop.

## How to Fix It

You should simply remove the `item` prop from your Grid components. The official migration guide shows you can safely remove them: `-<Grid item zeroMinWidth>` becomes `+<Grid>`.

If you're on Material UI v5 using the unstable import, the same applies: the `item` and `zeroMinWidth` props have been removed in Grid v2 — `-<Grid item zeroMinWidth xs={6}>` becomes `+<Grid xs={6}>`.

## Background Context

There was a known issue with the migration/warning experience. In the MUI team's rollout plan discussion, they noted problems including that they need a custom prop type that clearly explains this is a Grid v1 prop that can now be removed. There was also no clear prop-type warning when doing `<Grid2 xs={12}>` — the attribute gets silently applied to the DOM.

## Version Notes

If you're on MUI v6, note that the Grid component has been stabilized and marked as stable in Material UI v6, so the unstable prefix for the Grid is removed. You can use `import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid2'` or `import { Grid2 } from '@mui/material'`. Additionally, the size and offset properties for corresponding breakpoints have been renamed — so you'd use `<Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>` instead of the older `xs={12} sm={6}` syntax.

**In summary:** The console warning originates from MUI's Grid v2 implementation flagging deprecated Grid v1 props. The fix is to remove the `item` prop entirely (and, on v6+, migrate breakpoint props like `xs`/`sm` to the new `size` prop).

The primary authoritative sources are the official MUI migration guides ([mui.com](https://mui.com/material-ui/migration/upgrade-to-grid-v2/) and the [v5 guide](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/migration/migration-grid-v2/)).
